newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo April construction work falls.
newsitem.headline: Yugo April construction work falls.

text.p: the Federal Statistics Office reported the following economic indicator:
Completed works (in million dinars) 195.906 234.864 187.845 Hours (in million hours) 7.947 7.440 8.169
NOTES -- Cumulative number of workers in January-April period dropped six percent against the same period in 1996.
Cummulative numbers of hours put in by workers in the first four months this year was down five percent against the same period the previous year.

At the end of April, the value of concluded building contracts stood at 1.851 billion dinars compared to 1.547 billion dinars the previous month. The data refer to contracted construction works to be carried out during the year regardless of when the orders were made.
The data covers major construction companies accounting for around 80 percent of total annual value of construction works.
The number of workers excludes engineers and technicians.
The number of put in hours exclude hours put in by engineers and technicians.
Figures refer to Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro.
